responsibility: Implements the core executable logic of the PDP-11 target backend and binds it into GCC’s target hook structure. This file defines target hooks for assembler emission, section handling, costs, argument passing, return values, trampolines, register availability, legal constants, scalar-mode support, hard-register mode rules, and stack rounding; it also provides PDP-11-specific real-format encode/decode routines for SF/DF, assembler dialect differences for DEC/GNU/Unix syntax, label and symbol output helpers, and other backend support functions that the md file and macros call during RTL expansion, reload, and final assembly output.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable C++ side of the PDP-11 port: target-hook implementations and helper routines that enforce or specialize behavior declared elsewhere. Unlike pdp11.h, which statically defines macros and ABI/assembler conventions, pdp11.md, which describes RTL patterns, and pdp11.opt, which only declares command-line flags, this file provides the runtime hook code that processes options, adjusts register usage, emits assembler details, and implements backend decisions.
